map.急性白血病分型按 MICM 综合判定：形态学（FAB 分型，AML 为 M0 至: Acute leukaemia classification follows MICM: morphology (FAB: AML M0-M7, ALL L1-L3), immunology (flow markers: myeloid CD13/CD33/MPO, lymphoid CD19/CD10/CD3), cytogenetics (t(15;17), t(8;21), inv(16), etc.) and molecular biology (PML-RARA, BCR-ABL1); bone marrow blasts at least 20% is the diagnostic threshold for acute leukaemia.
map.M0 - 急性髓系白血病微分化型: M0 - acute myeloid leukaemia, minimally differentiated
map.M1 - 急性髓系白血病未分化型: M1 - acute myeloid leukaemia without maturation
map.M2 - 急性髓系白血病部分分化型: M2 - acute myeloid leukaemia with maturation

map.提示：WHO 2016/2022分类已将AML分为\"重现性遗传学异常\"和\": Note: the WHO 2016/2022 classifications divide AML into "recurrent genetic abnormalities" and "AML defined by myelodysplasia-related changes", among others. FAB typing remains the morphological basis. For study reference only.

map.AML 按 FAB 形态学（M0–M7）查典型指标与阈值: For AML, look up typical indicators and thresholds by FAB morphology (M0-M7).

map.结合 MICM（形态/免疫/细胞遗传/分子）综合定型: Combine MICM (morphology / immunology / cytogenetics / molecular) for an integrated diagnosis.
map.FAB 形态学分型：AML 依骨髓原始细胞比例与分化（M0 微分化、M1 未成熟: FAB morphological typing: AML by blast proportion and differentiation (M0 minimally differentiated, M1 immature, M2 granulocytic, M3 promyelocytic (APL), M4 myelomonocytic, M5 monocytic, M6 erythroid, M7 megakaryoblastic); ALL split L1 (small uniform), L2 (large heterogeneous), L3 (Burkitt-like). Modern diagnosis uses MICM: immunophenotyping assigns lineage, karyotype / fusion genes (e.g. PML-RARA, AML1-ETO) assign prognosis and targets.
map.例（AML：骨髓原始粒细胞 45%、Auer 小体阳性、t(15;17) 阳性）: Example (AML: marrow blasts 45%, Auer rods positive, t(15;17) positive): FAB is M3 (acute promyelocytic leukaemia APL), immunology/molecular confirms PML-RARA fusion → high risk but curable, first-line all-trans-retinoic acid (ATRA) plus arsenic, avoid plain chemotherapy that can trigger differentiation syndrome.
map.FAB 仍是形态学沟通基础，但 WHO/ICC 现行分类更强调遗传学（如伴 RU: FAB remains the morphological communication basis, but current WHO/ICC classifications stress genetics (e.g. RUNX1::RUNX1T1, PML-RARA) and molecular markers; morphology alone misclassifies, so MICM must be combined.
map.M3/APL 因 t(15;17) 致 PML-RARA，对 ATRA+砷剂高度: M3/APL, driven by t(15;17) and PML-RARA, is highly sensitive to ATRA plus arsenic and curable, but the induction phase risks differentiation syndrome and bleeding (DIC); management differs from other AML, so it must be recognised early.
